proposed_record.reviewerRationale: Coverage value: MetOcean Telematics gains current activity anchored to the 2026-08-12 USCG iSLDMB call, updated NiKA, iSLDMB and satellite-telemetry capability fields, plus distinct PABLO and MASS records. Evidence: 34 durable sources from USAspending.gov, CanadaBuys, Frontiers in Marine Science, Petrobras, Iridium Communications and counterparties separate official awards, field use and vendor specifications. Mission/Public Need read: The underwater ISR relationship remains unchanged and no new mission match is proposed; the operating context records Dartmouth-based product design and manufacturing plus acoustic profilers, drifters, satellite terminals and naval scoring without implying fit. Unknowns: USCG unit counts and delivery acceptance, NiKA performance, MASS customer commissioning, ISO scope, production lead times and product accreditation remain unresolved. Reviewer action: Review current activity and iSLDMB maturity against call 70Z03826FD0000023, then compare PABLO, NiKA and MASS configuration boundaries before acceptance.
reviewWarnings: The three USCG iSLDMB calls establish obligations, not disclosed unit count, delivery, acceptance or operational performance.
The DND NiKA/PAMS award establishes a contract but does not publish delivered quantity, acceptance result or measured performance.
PABLO's independently documented Santos Basin use is environmental deployment evidence and must not be converted into defence validation.
NiKA transmits acoustic and position data after surfacing; public sources do not support continuous underwater satellite connectivity.
The UK Ministry of Defence MASS award is confirmed, but Royal Navy commissioning, acceptance, measured performance and operational use remain unverified.
KSSL and Indian Ministry of Defence records do not independently name MetOcean or NiKA, so that claimed contract linkage remains excluded.
ZeroUSV and third-party coverage identify the Oceanus12 satellite stack but do not independently identify MetOcean's integration role.
No independent current ISO certificate number, scope, sites or expiry was recovered for MetOcean's quality claim.
Bracer FIPS status conflicts between the current page and the 2023 sheet, and no NIST certificate or module number was found.
STREAM1 cold-temperature claims conflict between the current product advisory and the version 7 specification.
Controlled Goods registration is confirmed, but personnel, facility, cybersecurity, data-residency and product-accreditation scope remains undisclosed.
The CAD 15.142 million Shared Services Canada contract is an as-required ceiling and does not establish realized spend or use by every named partner organization.
Public sources do not disclose product-level production capacity, backlog, unit pricing, domestic workshare or standard delivery lead time.
